summary:
Implemented the complete Windows-only platform layer, built and ran its tests, copied the bundled tzdata tree and migrated every assigned time-zone call site.

What was built:
- File system: descriptor-relative operations via NtCreateFile/RootDirectory, no-follow opens with name-surrogate reparse checks and a reopen for non-surrogate reparse points, POSIX-semantics rename/unlink with a 2 s bounded retry, LockFileEx at 0x4000000000000000 (length 1), private SDDL creation with explicit owner plus owner/DACL checks, realpath via GetFinalPathNameByHandleW, long paths through NT paths, directory listing, ACL-accurate access probe, disk space, and path helpers using CompareStringOrdinal.
- Processes: CreateProcessW with an explicit handle list, MSVCRT quoting, a sorted case-insensitive environment block, caller-owned binary pipe fds or owned overlapped pipes with communicate/communicate_async (timeout, output cap, cancellation, grandchild grace), wait/watch/terminate, detached spawn, and relaunch through an inherited self handle.
- Termination: named event Local\RadioS-stop-<pid> plus a console ctrl handler; request_stop.
- Startup helpers: parent-console attach/detach, log sink with rotation, UTF-8 argv, executable path, radios_platform_init hardening (DLL search incl. GLib dir, error mode, binary fmode and std streams, heap termination).
- Crash dumps: dedicated writer thread, private dump files, SEH and abort, keeps the newest 10.
- Time zones: ICU-first per D3, with each registry zone validated against the bundled tzdata (1 year back to 5 years ahead) and a GLib-safe TZif footer fallback. Each IANA id gets its own GTimeZone, so get_identifier is exact. Also exists/list, and radios_date_time_format for %Z ("+03").
- tests/test_platform.c: 31 GLib tests; the executable doubles as its own helper process.
- runtime\share\zoneinfo: 604 files from the hash-checked tzdata 2026.5 wheel, without __init__.py.

Time-zone migration: 14 source files plus 3 test files now use radios_time_zone_new / radios_time_zone_identifier_exists. header_status uses radios_date_time_format so the tooltip still shows "+03", which tests/test_header_ui.c asserts.

Deviations from D3 (reasons are in the header):
- "Etc/UTC" gets its own UTC0 zone instead of the UTC singleton, so its identifier round-trips; "UTC" stays the singleton.
- identifier_exists and radios_time_zone_new require the bundled TZif file when the tree is present, to match the service's zoneinfo ("PST" is rejected). An id known only to ICU is accepted only when the tree is missing.
- RADIOS_SPAWN_DETACHED uses CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB, not DETACHED_PROCESS (avoids visible consoles for grandchildren and keeps logoff/shutdown events).
- Termination follows the core-spec add/remove_termination_watch API, not the UI spec's RadioSTermination.
files_created: C:\Users\sonatturkan\Desktop\RadioS\runtime\share\zoneinfo\** (604 files: 598 TZif zones + leapseconds + iso3166.tab, zone.tab, zone1970.tab, zonenow.tab, tzdata.zi; extracted from packaging\windows\cache\tzdata-2026.5-py2.py3-none-any.whl after sha256 check, __init__.py excluded)
api:
The full contract and documentation are in include/radios/platform.h (Windows-only, no windows.h in the header). All spec section 3 functions exist with the spec signatures:
- init and errors: radios_platform_init, radios_platform_set_io_error, radios_platform_errno_from_win32.
- Open flags RADIOS_O_* (Windows values), RADIOS_AT_FDCWD/REMOVEDIR; RadioSFileInfo, radios_file_info_same/_is_hidden.
- Path-level: radios_fs_stat/open/unlink/rename/mkdir_with_parents/realpath/dir_check_access/disk_space.
- Descriptor-relative: radios_fs_open_root/open_nofollow_path/openat/statat/mkdirat/unlinkat/renameat.
- Descriptor ops: radios_fd_stat/list_names/pread/pwrite/seek/truncate/sync/sync_dir/close/lock, with RADIOS_LOCK_SH/EX/NB/UN and RADIOS_LOCK_REGION_OFFSET 0x4000000000000000, length 1.
- Privacy: RadioSPrivateCheck, radios_fd_is_private, radios_fs_path_is_private, radios_fd_make_private, radios_fs_path_make_private.
- Path strings: radios_path_is_absolute/is_root/equal/is_inside/normalize/component_valid/split/to_portable/from_portable.
- Process identity and threads: radios_process_executable_path, radios_process_remember_argv, radios_process_argv, radios_process_id, radios_thread_lower_priority.
- Termination: radios_process_add_termination_watch(GSourceFunc, data, notify) -> guint, radios_process_remove_termination_watch(id) (call at the END of teardown), radios_process_request_stop(pid, GError**), radios_process_spawn_detached(argv, cwd, GError**).
- Test support: radios_platform_test_symlink, radios_platform_test_make_public.

D3 and UI-spec additions:
- radios_platform_install_crash_handler(log_root, GError**) writes <log_root>\crash\RadioS-<UTC>-<pid>.dmp.
- RadioSProcess *radios_process_spawn(const gchar *const *argv, const gchar *cwd, const gchar *const *envp /*NULL=inherit*/, guint flags, gint *stdin_fd, gint *stdout_fd, gint *stderr_fd, GError **error). Flags: RADIOS_SPAWN_DETACHED, _STDIN_PIPE, _STDOUT_PIPE, _STDERR_PIPE, _STDERR_TO_STDOUT, _NULL_STDIO, _PASS_SELF_HANDLE. With a NULL fd pointer the pipe stays inside the process object for communicate().
- guint32 radios_process_get_id(p); gboolean radios_process_wait(p, guint timeout_ms /*RADIOS_PROCESS_WAIT_INFINITE*/, gint *exit_code); guint radios_process_watch(p, GMainContext*, RadioSProcessExitFunc(p, exit_code, data), data); gboolean radios_process_terminate(p, gint exit_code); void radios_process_free(p).
- gboolean radios_process_communicate(p, GBytes *stdin, gsize max_bytes, guint timeout_ms, GBytes **out, GBytes **err, gint *exit_code, GCancellable*, GError**), plus radios_process_communicate_async/_finish.
- gchar *radios_process_quote_command_line(argv); gchar **radios_process_environment(overrides: "NAME=V" sets, bare "NAME" removes, case-insensitive); gchar *radios_process_stop_event_name(pid).
- Startup: gboolean radios_platform_attach_parent_console(void); void radios_platform_detach_console(const gchar *log_dir); gboolean radios_platform_stdio_is_usable(fd); gboolean radios_platform_redirect_stdio_to_log(log_dir, GError**) (radios-desktop.log, rotated to .1 above 5 MiB); gchar **radios_platform_get_argv(argc, argv); gboolean radios_platform_relaunch_wait(guint timeout_ms).
- Time zones: const gchar *radios_time_zone_directory(void); gboolean radios_time_zone_identifier_exists(id); GTimeZone *radios_time_zone_new(id) (NULL id = local zone, unknown or non-IANA id = NULL); const gchar *radios_time_zone_get_identifier(GTimeZone*) (interned string); gchar **radios_time_zone_list_identifiers(void) (468 sorted ids); gchar *radios_date_time_format(GDateTime*, format) (%Z gives the tzdata abbreviation).

Link: -lntdll -ladvapi32 -lshell32. icu.dll and dbghelp.dll are loaded dynamically from System32.
verification: Strict compile, D7 recipe (gcc 16.2 UCRT64, -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror, D7 defines and pkg-config cflags), OK with no warnings: src/core/platform.c, platform_tz.c, platform_win32.c, tests/test_platform.c, the 14 migrated sources (weekly_programme_plan, automation_calendar_plan, loudness_policy, playout/automation_policy, ui/audio_ui, header_status, header_navigation, automation_calendar, broadcast, local_event_prepare, instruments, player_rotation, probability_editor, schema_track_picker) and tests/test_automation_calendar.c.

tests/test_autoplay_header_ui.c and tests/test_header_playout_ui.c do not compile, but the errors are in the included tests/test_playout_ui.c (g_stat with struct stat at line 333, pread at line 344, not my file); my migrated lines in them were not compile-tested.
Built test_platform.exe (link -lntdll -ladvapi32 -lshell32 -Wl,--stack,8388608) and ran it with G_DEBUG=fatal-warnings and RADIOS_TEST_PROJECT_ROOT set: 31/31 pass. The agent session is elevated.
Same suite under runas /trustlevel:0x20000 (whoami shows BUILTIN\Administrators as deny-only): 31/31 pass, so the non-admin owner/ACL paths are exercised too.

What the suite covers: path truth tables; NTFS-vs-radios_path_equal case folding for Turkish letters; Turkish names for create/rename/unlink/stat/list; long paths over 260 characters; 600-entry listing across several buffers; open flags; device-name guard; atomic replace with a FILE_SHARE_DELETE holder (immediate) and a plain _wopen holder (released after 400 ms: succeeded after about 620 ms; held over 2 s: EBUSY after about 2010 ms); unlinking an open file and recreating the name at once; junction/symlink no-follow returning ELOOP and LINK; private file/dir TRUE, made-public file FALSE, make_private restores; realpath of C:\Users\SONATT~1\... giving C:\Users\sonatturkan\AppData\Local\Temp; disk space; ACL-accurate access probe (read-only DACL gives EACCES); sparse file pread/pwrite past 2 GiB and truncate to 2 GiB+1.

Locks: SH/EX/NB semantics, SH<->EX conversion, a blocking waiter thread, the lock region not blocking data I/O, and two processes (helper holds SH -> our EX|NB gets EWOULDBLOCK; our EX -> helper's try-lock exits 11).

Time zones in the suite: Europe/Istanbul 2015-01 = +02:00, 2015-07 = +03:00, 2026-10 = +03:00; New York DST edges 2026-03-08 07:00Z and 2026-11-01 06:00Z; Berlin 2026-03-29 01:00Z; Etc/UTC; unknown and invalid ids give NULL; aliases round-trip exactly with distinct objects; Noronha -02 (UTC-02 sign guard); Dublin negative DST with GMT/IST abbreviations; America/Coyhaique and Antarctica/Troll via the TZif fallback; list has 468 ids; all 598 bundled zones load and round-trip; thread safety; %Z gives "+03"/"CEST"/"EST".

Processes in the suite: runtime\python\python.exe -E -s -B -X utf8 -c print('Türkçe ğüşiöç') returns exact UTF-8 bytes, through both an owned pipe and a caller CRT fd; 1 MiB stdin->stdout echo; output cap; envp dedupe and radios_process_environment; Turkish cwd; exit codes 3/7/5; 300 ms timeout terminates (exit 1); terminate gives 42; cancel; detached spawn; validation errors; quoting checked against CommandLineToArgvW and a real child; an inheritable event handle of ours is absent in the child; GetConsoleWindow()==NULL in the child; watch and communicate_async; stop event fired twice by another process calling radios_process_request_stop.

Startup and crash in the suite: relaunch chain prints waited=1 and the variable is consumed; log sink in a helper with no std handles, including rotation; crash dumps for an access violation (exit 0xC0000005) and abort() (exit 3), MDMP magic, private ACL, retention of 10.

Separate comparison of radios_time_zone_new against Python 3.14.8 zoneinfo on the same tree, all 598 zones, 2025-11-01..2031-10-01: 587 identical. The 11 differences are only before mid-2026 (Casablanca/El_Aaiun Ramadan 2026; Edmonton/Inuvik/Yellowknife/Canada-Mountain, Vancouver/Canada-Pacific, Winnipeg/Rainy_River/Canada-Central before their 2026 switch to permanent time); from now on they match. All 598 ids distinct and round-trip. First zone creation about 1.2 ms, cached lookup about 0.07 µs.

Probes behind design decisions: kernel32 FileRenameInfoEx rejects a RootDirectory (error 87) while NtSetInformationFile accepts it; GLib reads Windows ids like UTC-02 as POSIX strings with the sign inverted (26 zones); GLib's registry reader gives +04 for Volgograd in 2026 although the registry says +03; GLib's POSIX parser mis-evaluates Dublin's negative DST; ICU 2022g leaves 11 tzdata ids unmapped; the probe process is elevated and new files are owned by BUILTIN\Administrators.
industrial_fixes: Time zones: GLib reads the Windows ids UTC-02/UTC+12/UTC-11/UTC-08/UTC-09/UTC+13 as POSIX strings with the sign inverted (26 IANA zones, e.g. America/Noronha, Pacific/Tarawa). These ids are never passed to GLib.

Time zones: ICU 2022g mappings are stale for zones changed since 2022 (Almaty/Qostanay, Chihuahua/Ojinaga, Scoresbysund, Casey, Alberta/BC/Manitoba 2026), and GLib's registry reader is wrong for Volgograd. Every registry zone is now checked against tzdata over 1 year back to 5 years ahead, with a footer fallback, so present and future offsets are correct.
Time zones: GLib mis-evaluates negative-DST TZ strings (Europe/Dublin footer gave +2 in January). Footers are rewritten into the equivalent positive-DST form before GLib sees them.

Time zones: GLib caches zones by identifier string, so IANA aliases sharing one Windows zone shared one object and reverse lookups would return the wrong city. Case variants of registry names and equivalent offset spellings give one object per id.

Time zones: registry zones carry localised names, so %Z would have shown 'Türkiye Standart Saati' instead of '+03' (tests/test_header_ui.c asserts '+03'). Added radios_date_time_format and used it in header_status.

Time zones: the loudness-policy check split ids on '/' only, so '..\..\Windows\win.ini' would pass on Windows. The strict IANA syntax rejects '\' and ':'; ids must match the on-disk case exactly; unknown ids are no longer interned (bounded miss cache, no unbounded growth from input).

File system: kernel32 SetFileInformationByHandle(FileRenameInfoEx) rejects a RootDirectory. renameat uses NtSetInformationFile FileRenameInformationEx (POSIX semantics, ignore read-only) with a classic-rename fallback and a bounded 2 s retry.
File system: _get_osfhandle returns -2 for std fds of a GUI process, which equals the GetCurrentThread() pseudo-handle. These are now treated as EBADF instead of operating on the thread handle.
File system: GetFullPathNameW turns names like '<dir>\CON' into devices. Such results are rejected (EINVAL) so a file path never opens a device.
File system: a no-follow O_TRUNC no longer truncates a reparse point itself; truncation happens after the link check. APPEND|TRUNC keeps write access.
File system: ftruncate uses FileEndOfFileInfo (O(1)) instead of _chsize_s, which writes zeros when extending.
File system: creating a name that another program deleted (delete pending) is retried; sharing violations on opens are retried within the 2 s budget.

Privacy: radios_fd_make_private produced no change for an owner-only but non-writable DACL. It now sets the canonical private DACL (user full control), then sets the owner to the user through a reopen. This works for Administrators-owned files left by elevated runs, without needing WRITE_OWNER beforehand.

Processes: spawning uses an explicit handle list (verified: an inheritable handle of ours never reaches the child), requires an absolute program path (no PATH/CWD/Store-alias hijack), and rejects .bat/.cmd because cmd.exe re-parses the command line (injection).
Processes: the environment block is sorted and deduplicated case-insensitively, last definition wins. GLib's case-sensitive environ helpers could otherwise produce duplicate Path/PATH entries.

Processes: owned pipes are private named pipes (owner/SYSTEM DACL, remote clients rejected). communicate cannot hang when a grandchild keeps the pipes open (1 s grace after exit), drains output beyond the cap, and supports cancellation and timeout.
Startup: fixed a log-sink redirection bug where the log fd took number 1 after stdout was closed and was then closed again.
Startup: std streams are switched to binary, because the CRT opens them in text mode before main and the _set_fmode decision alone does not cover them.

DLL hardening: SetDefaultDllDirectories plus AddDllDirectory(directory of libglib) keeps dev/test runs loading GTK/GIO modules from MSYS2 while C:\MinGW\bin on PATH is never searched; SetDllDirectoryW(L""), safe SearchPath mode, SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS|SEM_NOOPENFILEERRORBOX, heap termination on corruption.

Crash dumps: written by a dedicated thread so stack overflows are covered, with a private ACL because dumps contain tokens and credentials, a newest-10 retention to survive crash loops, and an abort() hook.
Termination: a stop event pre-created by someone else is reset at start so a stale request does not fire; console close/logoff/shutdown waits (up to 4.5 s) until the teardown releases it.
requests_for_other_areas: Owner of include/radios/station_time.h (UI): radios_station_now() still calls g_time_zone_new_identifier, which returns NULL for IANA ids on Windows, so every station clock silently falls back to UTC. Change it to radios_time_zone_new(radios_station_timezone(ctx)) and add #include "radios/platform.h". This is the only call site left.

Integrator/CMake: add src/core/platform.c, platform_tz.c and platform_win32.c to radios_core and link ntdll, advapi32 and shell32 (icu.dll and dbghelp.dll are loaded at runtime from System32). Add a test_platform target with RADIOS_TEST_PROJECT_ROOT="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}", -lshell32 and the 8 MiB stack. Set TZDIR=<root>/runtime/share/zoneinfo for the C tests. Make staging and installer scripts keep and ship runtime/share/zoneinfo as <prefix>\share\zoneinfo.

UI area, app/main.c: call radios_platform_init() first, then radios_platform_relaunch_wait(30000) and radios_platform_attach_parent_console(). Parse arguments from radios_platform_get_argv() with g_option_context_parse_strv, and call radios_process_remember_argv(). Call radios_platform_install_crash_handler(<root>\data\logs). If !radios_platform_stdio_is_usable(2), call radios_platform_redirect_stdio_to_log(log_root). Call radios_platform_detach_console(log_root) once the window is shown.

UI area, app/main.c termination: use radios_process_add_termination_watch(cb -> g_application_quit) and call radios_process_remove_termination_watch(id) at the END of the teardown. WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION handling stays in the UI's GDK filter.

UI area, data.c and admin_ui.c: replace GSubprocess with radios_process_spawn(argv = {python, "-E", "-s", "-B", "-X", "utf8", script, ...}, cwd = root, envp = radios_process_environment({"PYTHONUTF8=1", "PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8", "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1", "PYTHONHOME", "PYTHONPATH", NULL}), RADIOS_SPAWN_STDOUT_PIPE|RADIOS_SPAWN_STDERR_PIPE, NULL, NULL, NULL, &error). Then use radios_process_communicate_async(max 64 KiB or 1 MiB+1, timeout) and radios_process_terminate on destroy. The returned GBytes must be checked with g_utf8_validate.
UI area, reset_ui.c: relaunch with radios_process_spawn(..., RADIOS_SPAWN_DETACHED|RADIOS_SPAWN_PASS_SELF_HANDLE, ...). admin_ui.c restore command display: use radios_process_quote_command_line.

Python area (sdbase/_platform.py, tools/_platform.py): mirror the lock region (OffsetHigh=0x40000000, Offset=0, length 1, unlock before every lock), the private SDDL with explicit owner O:<user SID> (the C owner check accepts BUILTIN\Administrators only while the user is an effective admin; elevated runs otherwise create Administrators-owned files), and the stop event name Local\RadioS-stop-<pid>. Also write the lock interop test from core-posix-files.md 7.3 #10.

Owner of tests/test_playout_ui.c: g_stat with struct stat (line 333) and pread (line 344) must be ported to radios_fs_stat/radios_fd_stat and radios_fd_pread. Until then test_autoplay_header_ui.c and test_header_playout_ui.c, which include it, cannot compile.

Core and UI owners using the platform API: radios_fs_openat/statat/mkdirat/unlinkat with a directory fd require one valid component, so '.', '..', separators and reserved names (CON, NUL...) are EINVAL. Directory links and junctions are removed with RADIOS_AT_REMOVEDIR or radios_fs_unlink. Code that formats %Z should use radios_date_time_format.
open_issues: Zones whose Windows registry mapping fails the tzdata check now use the TZif footer, so offsets before their last rule change are approximated. This covers the UTC±hh family, Volgograd and zones changed since 2022. Europe/Istanbul and other zones that pass the check keep full registry history.

Casablanca/El_Aaiun (Ramadan 2026) and the Canadian zones that switched in 2026 differ from tzdata only for dates before mid-2026; today and the future match. GLib on Windows has no API to build arbitrary TZif transitions, so this cannot be exact.
Console Ctrl+C/close/logoff events and real session end were not tested automatically (no console in the harness); the named-event path is tested. WM_ENDSESSION belongs to the UI.
The non-admin run used runas /trustlevel:0x20000 (Administrators deny-only, still high integrity), not a real medium-integrity UAC-filtered token.
Without TZDIR, an executable outside the project tree falls back to MSYS2's share\zoneinfo (dev only). Tests inside the project, runtime\bin and installed builds find runtime/share/zoneinfo.
test_platform's timing assertions (replace waits at least 250 ms; give-up after 1.9 to 4 s) assume an otherwise normal machine; antivirus scanning could stretch them.
In --verbose output GLib-GIO-DEBUG lines appear. They come from GIO's own Windows app-info scan thread (GLib behaviour), not from this code.

If more than about 10 aliases ever share one footer-route rule, the object would be shared and radios_time_zone_get_identifier would return the first id. The current tzdata has at most 9 ids per footer, and the constant-offset spellings give 8 to 20 variants.
